verses.text: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.

segments.text: Praise ye Jehovah.
Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah,
That delighteth greatly in his commandments.

verses.text: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.

segments.text: His seed shall be mighty upon earth:
The generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.text: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.

segments.text: Wealth and riches are in his house;
And his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.text: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: He is gracious, and merciful, and righteous.

segments.text: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness:
He is
gracious, and merciful, and righteous.

verses.text: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.

segments.text: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth;
He shall maintain his cause in judgment.

verses.text: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

segments.text: For he shall never be moved;
The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

verses.text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.

segments.text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings:
His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.

verses.text: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see his desire upon his adversaries.

segments.text: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid,
Until he see
his desire
upon his adversaries.

verses.text: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.

segments.text: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy;
His righteousness endureth for ever:
His horn shall be exalted with honor.

verses.text: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.

segments.text: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved;
He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away:
The desire of the wicked shall perish.
